en-US.description: Card pool generator originally built for the 25 Format
en-US.longDescription: Card pool generator for trading card games, originally built for the 25 Format community. Fetches card data from YGOProDeck, enriches it with errata history from Yugipedia, applies configurable word-count rules, and exports eligible card pools to Excel/CSV. Join us at discord.gg/wDXgNHukb.
